integrity: All probability formulas and inversion steps are proved in RESULT.md; check.py independently tests finite instances, but numerical integration alone does not establish universal validity.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple metric graphs with positive lengths only; population-level edge-mixture distance germs required.
Edge labels specify sampling mixtures but are unobserved after sampling; fully labeled recovery is asserted for graphs with at least five vertices.
Triangle/claw cannot be distinguished by any such zero-radius germ; finite-sample stability unproved.
No independent originality certification or independent mathematical audit is asserted.
title: Edge-selective short-distance laws reconstruct finite metric networks up to a sharp Whitney obstruction
